text: {"label":"Nail Biting, Skin Picking, and Mouthing","definition":"Assessment and treatment of body-focused repetitive behaviors such as nail biting, skin picking, face touching, and mouthing or pica, often automatically maintained, using competing stimuli, differential reinforcement, habit reversal, and feedback devices.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Targets body-focused habits in applied settings, unlike laboratory lever-pressing research, exposure-based treatment of obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders, or socially maintained aggression."}
